content.comment_body: I am using [product_name] with [version_no], which has channels AI1 and AI2. I want to configure them as digital inputs. How can this be done?

Hello, You can only use channels I7 and I8 as digital inputs; AI1 and AI2 are not configurable for this purpose. Please be aware that a channel cannot be used as both analog and digital input within the same program. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to configure specific analog input channels as digital inputs on the [product_name] ([version_no]). Another community member points out that only certain channels are available for digital input, and analog and digital configurations cannot be used simultaneously on the same channel. This reveals limitations in the hardware design and indicates that documentation could better address such use-cases.
analysis.user_expectations: The user assumes that analog input channels on the [product_name] can be switched to serve as digital inputs whenever required.
